card.name: Journal and institution names in news citations
card.fires_on: Words inside science-news citations: the word after a publication date, journal title words, and parts of institution names such as Pacific Northwest National Laboratory.

modes.label: Journal names
modes.description: Journal title words or the preposition just before a journal name in a study citation.
modes.example: In a study to be published May 7<< in>> mBio, the online open-access journal

modes.label: Institution names
modes.description: Words inside the name of a research institute or government department.
modes.example: developed at the Department of Energy's Pacific Northwest National<< Laboratory>>, uses methane

modes.label: Reference lists
modes.description: Author-list punctuation or journal words in a reference line.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a news story or reference where a journal or research institution name is being spelled out.
